CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   D. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.
   D. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   D. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   C. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Moral Values: Purity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Judge Deborah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kings David and Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Raising the Widow’s Son and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
